pages.title: Ceruclase Shield
pages.text: The Ceruclase Shield can build a temporary ice shell around the wearer, reaching about five blocks away. The other hand must not be eating or drinking. It has 500 durability and a seven-second cooldown after the dome ends.
The shell uses suitable empty or replaceable space and respects placement protection. Its ice melts after the holder stops maintaining it. The shield also halves accumulated fall distance.
